page.overview:
Who is Parker?

Parker is a major character from Prankster, the first story from Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Parker has brown hair that he puts too much gel on, especially on his forelock. He also has large, unbelievably white teeth and full lips. He goes to work in an impeccable suit. Based on the eyeballs Jeremiah finds during his birthday prank, Parker is implied to have blue eyes.
